records.observation: Constructor initializes communicator/process/thread map using preamble max thread count, loads jumpshot.colors, resets shared ObjDef category index to0, constructs opaque arrow category with width3 and start/final reflective handlers. Concatenates user undefined definitions into known lists returned by superclass; creates width1 state/event categories and handlers, keyed by event IDs with map overwrite semantics. Allocates reusable record objects and argument array; byte counter0 excludes preamble and adds delegated header/body read/skip return values without validating them. hasNext consumes stream each call, with no cached-ready guard; repeated peek can skip an unreturned category/primitive. next does not read/advance/reset: returns saved Primitive for kind1 or appends category topology to list and returns saved definition for kind3; other IDs null, remove no-op. Thus ordinary wrapper/converter peek/get sequence matters. Constructor sets supplied kind1, successful hasNext only sets1 or3: no COMPOSITE production in this decoder, resolving missing converter COMPOSITE-branch concern for this implementation. Rec types2/3 create or update state/event category metadata, return category. State definition with either handler missing creates/replaces both; with both present and same target updates existing category; differing targets only log then still return field statedef, potentially stale from previous definition. Existing target casts have no type checks. Bare5/cargo6/message7 skip etype-1; otherwise reflectively invoke mapped handler with reusable header and null/cargo/message, cast result Primitive, then mark used IDs and return kind1 only if non-null. IllegalAccessException and InvocationTargetException log and continue scanning (drawobj cleared first); direct NullPointerException in invocation block logs offending header/record and exits1. Other faults outside catch range or incompatible arguments/casts can escape. Pairing algorithms and copying of reused inputs remain delegated to unread Topo handlers. Constant4, collective8, source10 and time-shift11 bodies are skipped; no timestamp correction implemented here. Communicator9 read and added to ID map. Type1 replaces block stream then checks outer loop; type0 nulls stream then returns false via outer check. Unknown type logs and reads next header without known body skip/resynchronization. No header read-size EOF validation here; delegated stream/record behavior unread. getArrowCategory appends arrow topology every call. getYCoordMapList calls finish then createYCoordMapList. Unmatched count iterates only topology entries appended by category retrieval, sums partial-list sizes for TwoEventsMatching using int then widens to long; duplicate definitions/repeated next can append same topology and overcount; never-retrieved category topologies omitted. No sorting, cleanup finally, or output rollback here. Native/archive programs not executed; low-level records, handlers and ID map remain separate unread obligations.
